source_classification: Primary official product documentation, primary software/research sources, and vendors' own advertised price pages. No customer interviews, quotations, signed contracts or sales were collected.

models.role: complex coding and professional work at lower token prices
visual reasoning and precise computer use

model_caveats: Prices are text-token Standard rates in USD; prompt sizes above 272K receive 2x input/cache and 1.5x output rates for the full request. Batch/Flex is 50% of Standard; Fast is 2x.

API tool calls and infrastructure are additional: web search USD10/1000 calls plus search content tokens; file search USD2.50/1000 calls; hosted shell/code-interpreter containers are priced by session/size.
A public model page or ChatGPT Pro subscription does not establish this study's API key access, quotas, billing, or trial entitlements. No live API calls were performed by the source-research task.

Published Astra API limits: Free unsupported; Build 5000 RPM/1M TPM/3M batch queue; Launch 10000 RPM/4M TPM/200M queue; Grow 15000 RPM/40M TPM/15B queue. Actual account limits must be checked, never inferred.

OpenAI's model capabilities and benchmarks are provider descriptions; they are not independent evidence of task accuracy in this study. Any modeled Beta success/latency remains an assumption or calibration, not a measured Astra result.
Do not assume proprietary weight access or unsupported fine-tuning. Use executable reduced-basis artifacts, workflows, supported external components or services.

interpretation_guardrails: ROM speedup is established scientific prior art; the study contribution must be causal lifecycle/economic integration, not invention of POD or model reduction.

A residual bound certifies error relative to the chosen discrete physics model; it does not certify mesh/discretization error, model-form correctness, uncertain boundary inputs, manufacturing feasibility or real-world safety.
Inverse design and robustness screening are existing service categories. Discovering them in a constrained agent experiment is portfolio discovery, not proof of a new market.
Give baselines sparse solvers, caching, factorization reuse when mathematically valid, and the option to adopt an existing ROM library. Otherwise measured Alpha may be withheld ordinary tooling.
For one-off work, customer data/model validation and integration may dominate solver cost. Repeated workloads and latency constraints are plausible but must be hypotheses until observed.
Published price schedules support possible economic scale, not a conversion probability, workload, or valid selling price for unmatched scope.

A benchmark frontier crossing is conditional on preregistered latency/quality/budget requirements; avoid claiming commercial qualification without user effort, contract obligations and physical validation.
Technical transfer uses a learned basis artifact and dependencies. Invoking a specialist service does not transfer the policy or intelligence to the caller.
selected_domain: Certified covariance and disturbance-energy analysis for stable linear dynamical systems; thermal and manufacturing lanes were excluded after owner coordination.

certificate_derivation.assumptions: Real A, stable strictly dissipative with (A+A^T)/2 <= -alpha I for independently established alpha>0; covariance X solves AX+XA^T+BB^T=0; no direct feedthrough for continuous-time H2.
certificate_derivation.bound: X-Xhat = integral_0^infinity exp(At) R exp(A^T t) dt; hence ||X-Xhat||F <= ||R||F/(2 alpha).
certificate_derivation.output: For J=tr(C X C^T)=||G||H2^2, |J-Jhat| <= ||C^T C||F ||R||F/(2 alpha).
certificate_derivation.derivation_status: Elementary derived bound from dissipative semigroup contraction, not a claimed new theorem. Sign of residual integral is as written because L(X-Xhat)=-R.
certificate_derivation.limits: Stability alone does not imply the alpha bound. If symmetric part fails, either establish a valid Lyapunov-operator separation/error bound or refuse this certificate. Bounds concern numerical solution of the stated model, not unmodeled dynamics, physical safety, all-parameter robust stability, demand or real sales.

commercial_calibration_suggestion.primary_reference: No matched vendor contract price for this proposed offline report was established.
commercial_calibration_suggestion.human_scope: Researcher-estimated 4–12 hours for a prevalidated stable model and specified disturbance report; separate additional time for real input/model qualification when needed.
commercial_calibration_suggestion.rate: An assumed USD120–180/hour billing band may be shown separately from wages and broader field-service pricing. USD150/hour is a transparent scenario, not a measured market quote.
commercial_calibration_suggestion.wage_anchor_arithmetic: USD120630/2080 = USD57.995/hour, using a disclosed 2080-hour convention. Any 2–3x billing multiplier is an assumption, not BLS evidence.
commercial_calibration_suggestion.screening_rule: If the learned specialist saves only a fraction of a CPU second per batch and baseline satisfies requirements, no premium or added demand should be assigned without a separate buyer-value hypothesis.
